_about: Everything the India opening movie uses (content/journeys/golden_triangle/public/assets/movies/gt_opening.mp4; made from this folder on 2026-11-17 as 'prototype 2' and adopted unchanged): 8 photos, one piece of music, four font families (6 files; the 2 the stamps need are in src/fonts/). Each entry gives the source, the author, the licence and what was changed. The paper texture, the map, the stamps, the tape and the gold line are drawn by the movie's own code (no outside material). The longer working notes of the search (all 27 photos gathered, the list of the first prototype) were not brought into the repository.
allowedLicences: Author's own, CC0, public domain, CC BY (any version). Never CC BY-SA, NC, ND or unknown.
creditNote: The movie shows no credit text. Its photos and music are credited in content/journeys/golden_triangle/manifest.json (openingMovie.credits), which the game shows in 出典・権利の一覧 → オープニングムービー. 6 photos are CC BY (delhi_india_gate, delhi_red_fort_facade, agra_taj_mahal_arch, term_parchin_kari, jaipur_hawa_mahal_night, jaipur_city_palace_peacock_gate), 2 are CC0 (delhi_qutub_minar, jaipur_amber_fort_hill; no credit required, listed all the same) and the music is CC BY 4.0.

photos.rightsNote: Seen small through the arch: the canopy with the 2022 statue of Subhas Chandra Bose (a recent sculpture). It IS visible in the movie's crop (about 10 x 30 px of the 720x1280 frame while the Delhi page is shown, a few pixels afterwards). It stands permanently in a public place (India's Copyright Act s.52 allows photographs of such works) and is a tiny, incidental part of the picture. (The note of prototype 1 said the crop left it out; that was wrong.) To leave it out, the lower edge of the crop would have to rise to about 74% of the file.
photos.peopleNote: DO NOT show the bottom 17% (y > 83%): close visitors with recognisable faces at the lower left, and a crowd at the foot of the arch.

movieUse.changes: Cropped to x 77-1843, y 0-1980 px of the 1920x2400 file, scaled down to 968x1085 px (Lanczos), converted from Display P3 to sRGB, saved as JPEG (quality 92). In the movie the picture is shown as a print on white paper with a wide lower margin, a handwritten caption (type) on that margin, a strip of drawn tape and a drop shadow; it is tilted and scaled, motion blur is applied while it moves, a drawn stamp may overlap its corner, and it stays, small, beside its city on the last picture.

fonts.source: npm package @fontsource/gelasio@5.3.0 (file files/gelasio-latin-500-normal.woff2), which carries the Google Fonts build
fonts.changes: The font file is unchanged (as it is in the package).
